THE TRAINER’S FIELD GUIDE

Know your ground.

01

Move, then make your move.

Draft six Pokémon from the shared pool first. A/D moves, W jumps. Each turn gives 125 movement points and one attack. A jump costs 18. Pick a partner with 1–6, then Q/E to choose its move.

02

Aim with confidence.

Click a landing area to find an arc, or use the sliders for classic manual aiming. Hold Shift while clicking for direct aim. Flip direction with F. Dots show the predicted arc; a ring marks the impact. Power changes arcs and relay landings, not beams. Space commits the attack.

03

Change the battlefield.

Most moves use long-range arcs. Relay moves send a Poké Ball to its landing marker, then summon there. Hydro Pump pushes, Earthquake breaks ground, Dig tunnels, salvos spread and clusters rain down. Three charged beams cross the whole arena.

04

Find a combination.

Water wets for two enemy turns and extinguishes burns. Electricity deals 50% more to wet trainers. Fire burns for 4 HP on each of two turns. Curse halves the rival’s next movement budget. Primaries have three shots and secondaries two. Strong moves also recharge. Ice slows wet targets; sludge poisons; Snarl weakens the next attack. If all shots are exhausted, remaining HP decides the winner.

Trainers have 180 HP. Falls can hurt; the sea is fatal. Blast damage fades with distance and is reduced by solid cover. Pokémon are summoned attackers and do not take damage in Trainer Battle.
